#### What's great

separating editing from publishing is the right call. a working draft that a human explicitly promotes to the live site, with version history to roll back to, is a much saner model than letting an agent write straight to production docs. preserving frontmatter, tables, and links while switching between visual and markdown mode without breaking structure is also a harder problem than it sounds.

#### What needs improvement [...] #### What needs improvement

the correction feedback loop isn't obvious from the pitch - if an agent's proposed doc update gets heavily edited or rejected by a human before publishing, does that correction feed back to the agent, or does it just try the same thing again next time?

#### vs Alternatives

Image 33: MintlifyMintlify

Mintlify is more of a full hosted docs platform tied to its own build pipeline. DocsAlot's pitch is narrower and more useful for us right now: a visual editor that sits on top of docs an agent can also read and write to through MCP, without committing to a whole new hosting stack.

### Engineering & Development

### LLMs [...] Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Faizan, the CEO of DocsAlot.

Today we’re launching DocsAlot MCP, so you can manage your knowledge base and help center from Claude, Codex, Cursor or another compatible MCP client.

One feature of the MCP I’ve been particularly enjoying is seeing what people ask in our docs. Our reader analytics surfaces those questions and recurring themes, helping us understand what needs a clearer explanation and what people want us to build next.

Recently, users were asking about an MCP server and how analytics works. Those questions informed our product direction and helped motivate this launch, including making those insights accessible through the official MCP integration. [...] faizan khan

@alheri\_murya Yes, it does. For this, once you connect the main website, github repo, and other things. It will automatically catch drifts.   
  
The good thing about this MCP is, you won't have to pay extra since you are already using your AI. We don't charge per drift detections.

would love to chat more about your use-case. Happy to buy you lunch in return for a call :)
